title: To: Laura Kent · From: Bayview Hotel · Subject: Your recent stay
L: Dear Ms. Kent, Thank you for your comments about your stay at the Bayview Hotel from August 2 to 5.
We are sorry that the air conditioner in your room did not work properly during your visit.
We understand how uncomfortable this must have been in such hot weather.
Our maintenance team has since replaced the units in all rooms on the sixth floor.
In addition, we would like to offer you a free night on your next stay.
Simply mention this e-mail when you make your reservation.
Sincerely, Paul Grant, Guest Relations Manager

exq.why: Thì theo ngữ cảnh: kỳ nghỉ đã qua (2–5/8, "during your visit") → quá khứ đơn: did not work.

exq.a: We understand how uncomfortable this must have been in such hot weather.
w: We are glad that everything in your room worked perfectly.
The air conditioners on your floor were replaced just before your arrival.
Unfortunately, we are unable to offer any compensation.
exq.why: Câu chèn tiếp lời xin lỗi về máy lạnh hỏng, trước câu nói đã thay máy. Mọi thứ hoạt động tốt ngược với lời xin lỗi; thay máy "trước khi chị đến" ngược với "has since replaced" (thay sau đó); không bồi thường ngược với câu tặng một đêm.
Từ nối giữa câu: đã thay máy, THÊM NỮA tặng một đêm miễn phí → In addition.
make your + danh từ: make a reservation (đặt phòng).
